summary: Mercury in the lagna is one of the best-agreed placements: every text read describes a learned, intelligent and pleasant-spoken person, and several add long life.
common_outcomes: Learned, intelligent, quick-witted (Phaladeepika, Saravali, Brihat Jataka, Jataka Parijata, Raman)
Sweet, skilful or clever speech (Phaladeepika 8.11; Saravali 30.38; Bhrigu Sutras)
Skill in poetry and mathematics; knows the right time and place (Saravali 30.38)
Humour, adaptability, wide reading (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Long life (Phaladeepika 8.11; Saravali 30.38)
Interest in mantra, tantra, occult study or astrology (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17; Raman)
Earns by writing; good as a physician; protects against other planets' longevity threats (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Pilgrimage in the 27th year (Bhrigu Sutras; Adawal); state as a text detail only

by_area.personality: Quick wit, mental ingenuity, humour, adaptability (Raman); quick, curious, youthful temperament (PanchangBodh); kind and forgiving (Bhrigu Sutras).
by_area.career: Earning through writing; aptitude for medicine (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary); scholarship (Jataka Parijata 8.58).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth with academic distinction (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); devoted to acquiring wealth as well as learning (Jataka Parijata 8.58).
by_area.health: Good health when Mercury is with benefics; skin, bile or jaundice trouble when with malefics (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); nervous trouble if Rahu or Ketu share the lagna (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Early marriage (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17); its 7th aspect brings talkative intelligence into partnership (PanchangBodh).
by_area.family: Happiness from brothers when Mercury is exalted or in own sign (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17).
by_area.spirituality: Listens devoutly to scripture, inclined to virtue and religion (Bhrigu Sutras; Jataka Parijata 8.58); learned in shastras (Phaladeepika 8.11).

strengtheners: Exalted or own sign: Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full (exaltation) through 3/4 (moolatrikona) and 1/2 (own sign) down to little in enemy signs
In a kendra in Gemini or Virgo it forms Bhadra Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Directional strength (digbala) in the 1st (PanchangBodh)
Good aspect from Venus gives musical and artistic talent (Raman)
Benefic association: health, wealth, grain, skill in logic and arithmetic (Bhrigu Sutras 1-17)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 14 deg (12 deg retrograde)
Debilitation in Pisces (Brihat Jataka 20.11 scale; Bhrigu Sutras)
Mercury turns malefic when joined or aspected by malefics (Bhrigu Sutras commentary on house 1)
Rahu or Ketu in the lagna with Mercury: nervous troubles (Raman)
Saturn conjunction: trouble to the left eye (Bhrigu Sutras 13)

disagreements: Sharp split. Brihat Jataka 20.6 (rogue), Jataka Parijata 8.65 (deceptive, vacillating) and Saravali 30.40 (cunning, fickle) are negative; Phaladeepika 8.11 is mixed (brave, good siblings, but dejected); Bhrigu Sutras, Chamatkar Chintamani, Raman and PanchangBodh are largely positive.
